column1: # Repositories considered and dropped, with the reason, so the selection can be audited.
# Every one of these was on the candidate list before any schema was read. All were dropped for the same mechanical
# reason: zero `.avsc` files at the commit checked. They are recorded because a selection that only lists what it
# kept cannot be distinguished from one that kept what it liked.

column4: schemas are defined in Java, not as .avsc files
